## First steps

This book uses the kit's defaults and nothing more. Chapters are plain Markdown files listed in `index.yml`, with no required opening summary.

::: {.note custom-style="note"}
The build adds the label to each callout, so the text starts with the point itself.
:::

A chapter can link to another one by its heading, as in [next steps](#next-steps), and can carry footnotes.[^notes]

[^notes]: Footnotes move to the end of the chapter in print.

::: {.tip custom-style="tip"}
Keep each callout to a short paragraph or two.

A second paragraph starts on its own line.
:::
